text.trigger: A player has a survivor at the Library.
text.vignette: In a dusty drawer of city plans you find an old sewer map, and the line on it runs from the colony's back fence straight to the hospital. Not a soul in camp wants to crawl through it, and someone must test it first.

options.clear-the-tunnel: Pick one of your survivors at the Library and roll a die; that survivor rolls exposure that many times. If they live, nobody rolls exposure when moving between the colony and the Hospital for the rest of the game.
